baseCurrency.title: Base currency
baseCurrency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code to convert from, e.g. "USD", "EUR", "GBP".

targetCurrencies.title: Target currencies
targetCurrencies.description: Comma-separated three-letter currency codes to check, e.g. "EUR,GBP,JPY". Leave blank for all available currencies.

daysBack.title: Compare to days ago
daysBack.description: Compute percent change versus the rate this many days ago (nearest available trading day is used for weekends/holidays).
